name: Good Boy!
source:
The outside world is scary, and neighborhood walks are boring, but one bright eyed pup can change everything. Duke is everything you could want in a dog, and his puppy vibes are shared by his shy but sweet owner, Milo. 

Good Boy! is a short but sweet romance VN where the player meets a cute pup, Duke, and his owner, Milo! Befriend Duke and Milo and bring the adorkable love interest out of his shell.

[From [url=https://lunamakaio.itch.io/good-boy]itch.io[/url]]
